purpose: 12 app background candidates for user review; no app integration yet.

images.title: London Eye · River light
images.scene: View across the Thames from Victoria Embankment toward the London Eye. The entire recognisable white observation wheel with individual capsules and its supports occupies the right half, backed by a pale blue sky with lively soft clouds. County Hall low beside it, naturally rippling water in the foreground. Fresh morning sun, subtle warm highlights and cool blue reflections. No bicycle.
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: One individual photographic background candidate for the BikeSpot London iPhone app.
Generate a single beautiful, believable editorial architectural photograph, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, 1536 by 1024 if possible. This belongs to a cohesive set of London backgrounds: crisp, geographically plausible architecture, natural texture, rich but restrained colour, subtle film grain, understated cinematic travel photography. Visually interesting and unmistakably London.
Composition: the app displays this in a shallow header with right-aligned cropping. Keep the main landmark entirely inside the rightmost 70 percent of the image, with its defining silhouette between 10 and 68 percent of image height. Leave air above it and give the lower quarter quieter river, pavement or planting that can fade underneath app content. The landmark must remain recognisable in a crop of the rightmost 80 percent of the frame. No extreme wide angle or leaning verticals. Compose an intentional photograph, not an empty generic stock background.
Constraints: ONE full-bleed image, no collage, no contact sheet, no text overlay, no caption, no logos, no watermark, no UI. No added invented landmarks. No large crowds, foreground portrait subjects, oversaturated HDR, artificial fog, or fantasy skyline.
